description: This file extends the Summernote WYSIWYG editor with Turkish language translations for UI elements such as fonts, images, videos, links, tables, styles, lists, options, paragraphs, colors, shortcuts, help, history, and special characters.

methods.name: immediately-invoked function expression (IIFE)
methods.description: Defines a function that extends the Summernote language options with Turkish translations and executes immediately with jQuery as the argument.
